metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Sure, take it and run’ and I’m still confused
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just grab a kill by pure accident?
Enemy must’ve been AFK or dreaming.
Click if your aim’s trash but the game still feeds you.
Valorant logic: serving freebies again.

Tap if your best plays are pure dumb luck!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
